elbow_flex.source: ACE Incline Chest Press: press to near full extension without completely locking out the elbows (15 degrees), keeping them slightly bent at the top; the bent start at the chest is illustrative at 90 degrees, matching a loaded machine start

shrug_cm.source: Gravitus Incline Chest Press: keep the shoulders drawn down and back through the whole press, packing the shoulder blades before each rep

torso_lean.source: Gravitus Incline Chest Press: keep the head, upper back and glutes in contact with the seat pads; don't excessively arch the lower back off the pad

muscles.peakSource: Gravitus Incline Chest Press: chest engagement is reduced by arching or by stopping short of near-full extension, so effort is highest approaching that near-locked-out top

mistake.name: Shrug and arch

tells.text: The shoulders rise toward the ears through the press.
The lower back arches off the pad to help finish the press.

mistake.source: Gravitus Incline Chest Press: letting the shoulders rise toward the ears during the press, and excessively arching the lower back off the pad, both reduce chest engagement and add joint stress

sources: Contact fact (backrest angle, unverified_on_machine): ACE / Gravitus give 30 to 45 degrees, but that is a real-world angle, not this app's `bench` setting unit, so it is not written into `machine.settings` here; the owner's gym checklist confirms the actual rig value
